internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Welcome to the captivating America's VetDogs ten-acre campus located at 371 East Jericho Turnpike/Middle Country Road in Smithtown, NY! This expansive campus serves as the heart of our organization, housing our National Administrative Center, Student Residence Hall, kennels, puppy nursery, and state-of-the-art training facilities. Situated just one hour east of Manhattan, Smithtown provides a tranquil setting for our life-changing programs.

network.coverage_note: The institution is a non-profit organization focused on guide dog training rather than an academic institution, so no Erasmus+ or academic mobility partners are listed. The provided partner list reflects corporate and military sponsors.
